notes: Seed set for MVP. Grow toward 30-50 items from real HR/IT questions (proposal.md §11.1). Sample corpus lives in testdata/handbook.

items.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get?
items.notes: Happy path: number plus PTO policy citation.

items.question: What's the difference between PTO and sick leave?
items.notes: Multi-document. Either source in the top 5 counts.

items.question: How do I reset my laptop password?
How many vacation days do I have left this year?
items.notes: Personal balance is out of scope in v1 (no HRIS).

items.question: Can I get reimbursed for a home espresso machine?
items.notes: Required decline. Documents cannot answer, and the model must not invent a stipend.

items.question: What is the salary range for a senior engineer?
items.notes: Audience probe. The compensation band is hr-only, so an employee must get a decline.
